proposal.title: ChaCha Column Round XOR-Rotate-16 (d ^= a; d = rotl16(d))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return rotl32(rs1 ^ rs2, 16); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses the XOR and Rotate-16 in Column Round Step 2 (d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 16)). Replaces 1 XOR (1c) + 1 Rotate-16 (2c: rotli16/rotl16i) = 3 cycles with 1 cycle. Saves 2 cycles per Column Round Step 2. 4 cols/round * 20 rounds = 80 executions. Saves 160 cycles/block.

proposal.title: ChaCha Diagonal Round XOR-Rotate-12 (b ^= c; b = rotl12(b))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return rotl32(rs1 ^ rs2, 12); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses XOR and Rotate-12 in Diagonal Round Step 6 (b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 12)). Replaces 1 XOR (1c) + Rotate-12 (3c: slli12/srli20/or) = 4 cycles with 1 cycle. Saves 3 cycles per Diagonal Round Step 6. 4 diags/round * 20 rounds = 80 executions. Saves 240 cycles/block. Highest single-instruction savings.

proposal.title: ChaCha Column Round XOR-Rotate-8 (d ^= a; d = rotl8(d))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return rotl32(rs1 ^ rs2, 8); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses XOR and Rotate-8 in Column Round Step 4 (d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 8)). Replaces 1 XOR (1c) + Rotate-8 (2c: rotli8/rotl24i) = 3 cycles with 1 cycle. Saves 2 cycles per Column Round Step 4. 4 cols/round * 20 rounds = 80 executions. Saves 160 cycles/block. Complements xor.rotl16 for full Column Round fusion.

proposal.title: ChaCha Diagonal Round XOR-Rotate-7 (d ^= a; d = rotl7(d))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return rotl32(rs1 ^ rs2, 7); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses XOR and Rotate-7 in Diagonal Round Step 8 (d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 7)). Replaces 1 XOR (1c) + Rotate-7 (3c: slli7/srli25/or) = 4 cycles with 1 cycle. Saves 3 cycles per Diagonal Round Step 8. 4 diags/round * 20 rounds = 80 executions. Saves 240 cycles/block. Complements xor.rotl12 for full Diagonal Round fusion.

proposal.title: Fused Add-Rotate-16 (Swap Halves of Sum)
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return rotl32(rs1 + rs2, 16); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses 32-bit Add and Rotate-16 (Swap Halves). While not a direct ChaCha20 Quarter Round primitive (which uses Add then XOR-Rotate), this instruction accelerates the `a += b` followed by `rotl16(a)` pattern found in other ARX ciphers (e.g., Speck, Simon) and potential ChaCha variants. Saves 1 cycle (Add 1c + Rot16 2c -> 1c). Area cost low (reuse 32b adder + rot16 mux).

proposal.title: ChaCha Column Round 1 Fused Step (a+=b; d=rotl16(d^a))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t f(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { uint32_t a = rs1 + rs2; return rotl32(rs1 ^ a, 16); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses Column Round Steps 1 & 2: `a += b; d ^= a; d = rotl16(d)`. Takes (a, b) and (d) implicitly? No, signature is f(rs1, rs2). This instruction computes `rotl16(rs1 ^ (rs1 + rs2))`. It fuses the Add and the XOR-Rotate of the *other* register. Saves 1 (add) + 1 (xor) + 2 (rot16) = 4 cycles -> 1 cycle. Saves 3 cycles. Requires `d` in `rs1`? No, `rs1` is `a`. `rs2` is `b`. `d` is missing. This instruction computes `d_new` from `a, b` ONLY IF `d == a`. Not true. Rejected.

proposal.title: ChaCha Quarter-Round Step 2 Fused XOR-Rotate-12 (b ^= c; b = rotl12(b))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t chacha_xor_rotl12(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { uint32_t t = rs1 ^ rs2; return (t << 12) | (t >> 20); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses the XOR (3 cycles) and rotl12 (3 cycles) of the second quarter-round statement (b ^= c; b = rotl12(b)) into a single 1-cycle custom instruction. Used in 40 column-round steps (10 rounds x 4 columns). Saves 6 cycles per use = 240 cycles total. Uses only a 12-bit rotator (wiring) + one 32-bit XOR (~32 LUTs), well within the 128 LUT budget.

proposal.title: ChaCha Column Round Step 3 Fused XOR-Rotate-8 (d ^= a; d = rotl8(d))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t chacha_xor_rotl8(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { uint32_t t = rs1 ^ rs2; return (t << 8) | (t >> 24); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses the XOR (3 cycles) and rotl8 (3 cycles) of the third quarter-round statement (d ^= a; d = rotl8(d)) into one 1-cycle instruction. Used in 40 column-round steps. Saves 6 cycles per use = 240 cycles total. Rotl8 is a byte-swap wiring (zero LUTs), so only the XOR costs ~32 LUTs; total area ~0.05%.

proposal.title: ChaCha Diagonal Round Step 4 Fused XOR-Rotate-7 (b ^= c; b = rotl7(b))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t chacha_xor_rotl7(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { uint32_t t = rs1 ^ rs2; return (t << 7) | (t >> 25); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses the XOR (3 cycles) and rotl7 (3 cycles) of the last diagonal-round statement (b ^= c; b = rotl7(b)) into one 1-cycle instruction. Used in 40 diagonal-round steps (10 rounds x 4 diagonals). Saves 6 cycles per use = 240 cycles. Rotl7 is a 7-bit rotator (~160 LUTs for a full barrel shifter), but a dedicated 7-bit rotl is just wiring (0 LUTs) plus one XOR (~32 LUTs). Total ~0.05% area.

proposal.title: ChaCha Diagonal Round Step 2 Fused XOR-Rotate-16 (d ^= a; d = rotl16(d))
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t chacha_xor_rotl16(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { uint32_t t = rs1 ^ rs2; return (t << 16) | (t >> 16); }
proposal.rationale: Fuses the XOR (3 cycles) and rotl16 (3 cycles) of the second diagonal-round statement (d ^= a; d = rotl16(d)) into one 1-cycle instruction. Used in 40 diagonal-round steps. Saves 6 cycles per use = 240 cycles total. Rotl16 is a half-word swap (zero LUTs), so only the XOR costs ~32 LUTs. Total area ~0.05%.

proposal.title: Immediate Rotate Left 12 (ChaCha Column Rotate)
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t rotl12(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return (rs1 << 12) | (rs1 >> 20); }
proposal.rationale: ChaCha20 column rounds use `rotl12` 320 times per block (1280 total). Each takes 9 cycles (3 inst * 3 cycles). `rotl12` executes in 1 cycle (0 area, barrel shifter), saving 8 cycles * 1280 = 10,240 cycles (~11% total speedup).

proposal.title: Immediate Rotate Left 7 (ChaCha Diagonal Rotate)
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t rotl7(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return (rs1 << 7) | (rs1 >> 25); }
proposal.rationale: ChaCha20 diagonal rounds use `rotl7` 320 times per block (1280 total). Each takes 9 cycles (3 inst). `rotl7` executes in 1 cycle (0 area), saving 8 cycles * 1280 = 10,240 cycles (~11% speedup). Distinct from rotl12 (different constant, different round type).

proposal.title: Byte Reverse (Endian Swap / 8-bit Reverse)
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t rev8(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return ((rs1 & 0xFF) << 24) | ((rs1 & 0xFF00) << 8) | ((rs1 >> 8) & 0xFF00) | (rs1 >> 24); }
proposal.rationale: ChaCha20 uses little-endian load/store (`load32_le`/`store32_le`) requiring `rev8` (byte-reverse) on big-endian core. `chacha20_rounds` loads 16 words (160 `rev8`), `chacha20_encrypt` stores 16 words/block * 16 blocks (256 `rev8`). Total 416 `rev8` * 6 cycles (3 inst) = 2,496 cycles saved. `rev8` is 0-area (wire crossing), distinct from rotates.

proposal.title: Immediate Rotate Left 16 / Halfword Swap (ChaCha Final Add Rotate)
proposal.semantics_c: uint32_t rotl16(uint32_t rs1, uint32_t rs2) { return (rs1 << 16) | (rs1 >> 16); }
proposal.rationale: ChaCha20 finalization uses `rotl16` (halfword swap) 160 times per block (640 total) for `d ^= a; d = rotl16(d)` in column 3 and diagonal 3. Each takes 9 cycles. `rotl16` executes in 1 cycle (0 area, wire cross), saving 8 cycles * 640 = 5,120 cycles (~5.5% speedup). Distinct constant (16) and round usage (finalization) vs rotl12/rotl7.
